description: Plotting scripts, source data and rendered panels for manuscript Figure 2 (panels a-j), packaged from the authoritative Figure 2 Main_select selection manifest.

directory_convention.scripts/<panel>/: registered plotting scripts for the manuscript panel (file names preserved)
directory_convention.data/<panel>/: small source-data files (CSV/JSON/SVG) read by the plotting scripts
directory_convention.outputs/<panel>/: selection-time rendered panel images (PNG/PDF, SVG where available)
directory_convention.panel: manuscript panel letter (a-j); selection ids of the source manifest are listed per panel

reused_or_copied_values.copied: byte-identical copy of the source file
reused_or_copied_values.copied_sanitized: copy with internal absolute path strings replaced by explicit placeholders
reused_or_copied_values.skipped_size: not redistributed because of the size rule
reused_or_copied_values.skipped_binary_array: not redistributed because it is a binary array or model checkpoint
reused_or_copied_values.not_bundled: present in the source workspace but deliberately not included

rules.paths: source_path is relative to the UltraMS research workspace root; target_path is relative to the ultrams_public_release repository root

large_items.what: Ion-polarity UMAP embedding arrays (`ion_polarity_mzmatched_{dreams,rt_only_d}_embeddings.npy`, 4.1 MB each)
large_items.how: Regenerate with `plot_ion_polarity_embedding_umap.py` from the MSnLib CSV and the released UltraMS / DreaMS checkpoints (see `benchmarks/spectral_properties/INPUTS.md`). The UMAP coordinates and plotted samples are included.

Regenerate with `original_feature_definition.py` / `compute_db.py` from the SpectraVerse split and the released supervised checkpoints; the frozen cluster metrics, DB summaries, UMAP coordinates and molecule SVGs are included.

large_items.what: Neutral-loss test predictions (`*.npy`) and trained task heads (`best_*.pt`, 25 MB each)
large_items.how: Predictions can be recalculated from the public MassSpecGym table and released checkpoints with `benchmarks/spectral_properties/original/neutral_loss/train_test_neutral_loss.py`; the exact ROC/AP records used by the figure (`config.json`, `roc_data.json`) are included.

large_items.what: Atom-query probe checkpoints for S/Cl/F/Br (`best_*.pt`, `last_*.pt`, 42 MB each)
large_items.how: The selected heads (UltraMS epoch 13, DreaMS epoch 1) are distributed as public benchmark assets: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/download_public_inputs.py --asset atom_query_heads`. The run configurations are included.

large_items.what: Peak-neighbor benchmark inputs: `peak_embeddings_ultra.npy` / `peak_embeddings_dreams.npy` (721 MB each), `peak_embedding_metadata.csv` (42 MB), `msnlib_magma_subset.csv` (21 MB), `msnlib_magma_annotations.json` (126 MB), and the UMAP coordinate tables `ultrams_peak_umap_coords*.csv` (24.8 MB each)
large_items.how: Download the frozen peak-neighbour assets with `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/download_public_inputs.py --asset peak_neighbors` (see `benchmarks/spectral_properties/INPUTS.md`), or rebuild them from the public MSnLib CSV with `prepare_msnlib_magma_subset.py`, `run_magma_msnlib_subset.py` and `extract_peak_embeddings.py`. The 24.8 MB UMAP coordinate tables can be regenerated by `plot_ultrams_peak_umap.py`.

panels.title: Masked-peak m/z reconstruction
panels.content: Masked-peak m/z reconstruction accuracy (UltraMS vs DreaMS) on GeMS-A10 and MassSpecGym; a hit is an absolute m/z error of at most 0.05 Da. The selection also registers a mean-absolute-error variant of this panel (fig2a_mae), which is not part of the current manuscript panel a.
panels.variants: accuracy panel plus the registered MAE variant
panels.reproduce: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/reproduce.py` recalculates the 0.05 Da accuracies from the saved reconstruction arrays. The figure script reads no external data file (the reported numbers are set in the script).

panels.title: Ionization-polarity recognition
panels.content: Ion-mode recognition: test F1 for [M-H]- and [M+H]+ with a frozen-embedding MLP probe.
panels.reproduce: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/reproduce.py` reports the saved ion-mode evaluation. `plot_task4.py` reads `polarity_linear_probe_combined.json` from the copied `data/b/ion_polarity/` directory.

panels.title: Negative-ion structure-family organization
panels.content: DreaMS vs UltraMS organization of model-independent negative-ion structure families (six RDKit Butina families, 661 SpectraVerse test molecules): frozen UMAP display subset, NMI / ARI / silhouette bars, and the database-index panel.
panels.reproduce: `render_compact_v2.py` re-renders the compact panel from the copied `data/c/source_data/` tables (`original_cluster_metrics.csv`, `db_summary.csv`, frozen UMAP coordinates, molecule SVGs). `compute_db.py` recomputes the DB index; it needs the large embedding arrays that are not redistributed (see below).

panels.title: Neutral-loss average-precision scatter
panels.content: Per-neutral-loss average precision of UltraMS against DreaMS (five losses); points above the diagonal favour UltraMS.
panels.reproduce: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/reproduce.py` recalculates ROC-AUC and AP from the 16,440 saved test predictions. The copied `data/d/nl_*/config.json` files hold the exact metrics used by the figure script.

panels.title: Neutral-loss ROC curves
panels.content: ROC small multiples for H2O (-18 Da), NH3 (-17 Da), CO2 (-44 Da), CO (-28 Da) and CH3 (-15 Da).
panels.reproduce: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/reproduce.py` recalculates the ROC-AUC values. The copied `data/e/nl_*/roc_data.json` files hold the exact ROC points used by the figure script.

panels.title: MAGMa fragment-attention cases
panels.content: MAGMa fragment-attention evidence cases for S-, F-, Cl- and Br-bearing molecules: attention spectrum, highlighted structure and top-4 annotated fragments.
panels.benchmark_code: MAGMa annotation modules in `benchmarks/spectral_properties/magma_support/`; atom-query heads from `benchmarks/spectral_properties/original/heteroatom_count/`; source table `benchmarks/spectral_properties/data/attention_examples.csv`
panels.reproduce: `atom_attention_viz_magma_v16_mixed_top4_row4.py` re-renders the case grid from the copied `data/f/*.plot_data.json`, `*.summary.json` and `*.peak_table.csv`. Regenerating the plot data from spectra needs the MAGMa annotation modules and the atom-query checkpoints (`benchmarks/spectral_properties/EXPERIMENTS.md`).

panels.title: Element-bearing peak hit rate
panels.content: Element-bearing peak hit rate versus Top-k peaks for S, F, Cl and Br (four methods, five repeats).
panels.reproduce: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/reproduce.py` reads the saved five-repeat hit-rate curves. `plot_hit_recall_curves_v1.py` re-renders the panel from the copied `data/g/attn_subspectrum_*` tables.

panels.title: Heteroatom-count regression
panels.content: Heteroatom-count regression: test R^2 for S, Cl, F and Br (UltraMS, DreaMS, Linear SVM, Random forest).
panels.reproduce: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/reproduce.py` recalculates the R^2 values from the saved predictions. The copied `data/h/atomq_*/config.json` files are the run configurations of the atom-query probes.

panels.title: Peak-token embedding UMAP
panels.content: Peak-token embedding UMAP property maps: fragment peak m/z, heavy atoms, hetero atoms, O/C ratio, parent cLogP and fragment chemotype.
panels.benchmark_data: `benchmarks/spectral_properties/data/peak_embedding_map.csv`; full peak embeddings are distributed as separate benchmark assets
panels.reproduce: `plot_ultrams_peak_umap.py` re-renders the maps from `peak_embedding_metadata.csv` and the two peak-embedding arrays; those large arrays are not redistributed (see below), the copied `data/i/x10/*.summary.json` record the plotted summaries.

panels.title: Cross-spectrum peak-neighbor fidelity
panels.content: Cross-spectrum peak-neighbor fidelity: formula agreement, fragment-family agreement, fragment-structure similarity and mass fidelity versus Top-k neighbors.
panels.reproduce: `python benchmarks/spectral_properties/reproduce.py` reads the published curves. `render_peak_neighbor_curves_from_data.py` re-renders the 2x2 panel from the copied `data/j/peak_neighbor_fidelity_metrics_x10.json` and curve tables.
